method: Standard six-card cribbage counting for four held cards plus one starter. Every scoring element is enumerated and added: 2 points for each distinct combination of two to five cards totalling 15 (ace 1, face cards 10); 2 points for each pair; the longest consecutive run, counted once per distinct ordering of the cards that make it (so 4-4-5-6 with a 7 cut is a double run of four); 4 points for a four-card flush or 5 for a five-card flush, except in the crib where only five cards in one suit score; and 1 point for his nobs, a jack in hand matching the starter suit. Assumes a standard deck, four held cards and no duplicate cards. His heels (2 for a cut jack) and pegging are not included, and no game score is tracked.
